role: Defines SessionArchive, the lock-guarded facade over the on-disk session archive (index.json, deleted.json, per-session encrypted JSON files in the App Group archive directory): init/boot, orphan adoption, archive/update/retrieve API and read-health counters.
types: SessionArchive: class (@unchecked Sendable) — archive facade; all index/tombstone/counter state guarded by archiveLock
state: mem:SessionArchive.newerBuildIndexEntries (IndexEntriesFromNewerBuild: index.json entries a newer build wrote, kept raw for saveIndex)
mem:SessionArchive.foldedInto (private [UUID: UUID]: recordings folded into a same-night session this launch, by their own id; archiveLock)
toplevel: static let shared = SessionArchive() builds the production instance lazily with default providers that read AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager.settingsSnapshot; `let fileManager = FileManager.default`, `let archiveLock = NSLock()`; stored providers sleepScheduleProvider/sessionMergeModeProvider/mergeGapProvider set in init.

units.does: Computed property returning a fresh ArchiveStore(archive: self) on each access; ArchiveStore holds no state.
units.contract: Returns a fresh ArchiveStore for this archive on each access; the store holds no state of its own.

units.does: Under archiveLock, returns true when permissionDeniedReadFailures > 10 and that count divided by max(1,totalReadAttempts) is > 0.5; drives the read-health banner in Settings diagnostics.
Under archiveLock, returns the (totalReadAttempts, permissionDeniedReadFailures) pair as one consistent snapshot for the diagnostics page.

After 'Delete All My Data' removed files, clears in-memory index, newerBuildIndexEntries, deletedSessionIds, the index / index-decode / deleted-index read-failure flags (so a save no longer tries to merge a purged, unreadable index), the fold map, sortedEntriesCache and sessionIdLookup under archiveLock, then resets the read-health counters. Does not touch disk.
Under archiveLock sets totalReadAttempts and permissionDeniedReadFailures to 0. Called by resetInMemoryStateAfterPurge and by the diagnostics page reset button.
Static shared JSONDecoder with ISO-8601 dates for full session decodes.
units.entry: Swift lazy static initializer, run on first access of SessionArchive.sessionDecoder

units.does: Static shared JSONDecoder with ISO-8601 dates and userInfo[.skipRRSeries]=true so HRVSession decoding skips the rrSeries array (lightweight reads).
units.entry: Swift lazy static initializer on first access of lightweightSessionDecoder

units.does: Static shared JSONEncoder with ISO-8601 dates and sortedKeys (byte-deterministic so SHA256 file hashes are stable) for session writes.
units.entry: Swift lazy static initializer on first access of sessionEncoder

units.does: Static shared JSONEncoder with ISO-8601 dates, prettyPrinted+sortedKeys, used for index.json and (per comment) archiveBatch session files.
units.entry: Swift lazy static initializer on first access of indexEncoder

units.does: Stores the three settings providers (defaults read AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager.settingsSnapshot), picks the archive directory (explicit test dir → App Group container → Documents → tmp), sets index.json/deleted.json URLs, creates the directory, loads index and tombstones synchronously, and logs the loaded count when 0 or >1000. Orphan reconcile is deferred to boot().

branches.effect: archiveDirectory = that directory; otherwise falls to the App Group check

branches.cond: App Group container URL is available

branches.effect: archiveDirectory = Documents/<archiveDirectoryName>; otherwise falls back to temporaryDirectory/<archiveDirectoryName> and logs at .error (sessions there can be purged by the OS)
logs '[Archive] Loaded N sessions'; otherwise no log

units.does: Deferred launch work run detached at utility priority from EmuquApp: retries a failed index.json / deleted.json load, adopts orphan session files into the index, and logs the tombstone summary.
units.entry: Called from EmuquApp.swift inside Task.detached after first paint

units.does: Under archiveLock re-reads index.json and deleted.json when their launch read failed (mergeIndexThatFailedToLoad, mergeDeletedIndexThatFailedToLoad), each inside attempt(), which logs and swallows any error.
Snapshots deletedSessionIds under the lock; if non-empty, logs a .warning when any tombstone's recorded deletion time is within the last 30 days, else an info line with the count.

branches.effect: logs warning-level summary (surfaces in Recent Problems); else logs info '0 recent'

units.does: Returns true if any id in the snapshot has a recorded deletion time (UserDefaults archive.deletionTimes via ArchiveStore.deletionTime) later than cutoff.

branches.effect: an id with no recorded deletion time counts as not newer (false)

units.does: Lists the archive directory (skipping hidden files); snapshots indexed file names and the tombstones, together with the sessions deleted forever (ForgottenSessions.ids), under the lock; builds entries for decodable non-indexed .json files of neither outside the lock; appends them via adoptOrphans.

Set of archive-directory file names that are never treated as session orphans: index.json, deleted.json and every file CloudKitSyncState writes there (sync_state.json, pending_uploads.json, quarantined_uploads.json, local_only_sessions.json, record_versions.json).

For one directory file: returns nil unless it is a .json that is not reserved, not indexed and not a tombstoned id; reads bytes, decodes via loadAndDecodeSessionFile (decrypting) inside attempt(); returns SessionArchiveEntry.make with SHA256 of the stored bytes, or nil with a log if unreadable.

branches.cond: not .json, or reserved name, or already indexed
file name is a UUID that is in the tombstone set
branches.effect: returns nil — intentionally deleted sessions are not resurrected
attempt logs a warning, then '[Archive] skipping undecodable orphan' and returns nil; file left on disk

units.does: Under archiveLock, filters out entries whose file is now indexed (concurrent archive), appends the rest to index and saves index.json via attempt (errors logged, swallowed); logs the adopted count after unlocking.
Public archive entry point: archive(session, skipSameNightMerge: false) (same-night merge allowed, no re-upload request).

Optionally stamps modifiedAt (whole seconds), then under archiveLock writes the session via _archive (merge unless skipped, encode, encrypt, hash, index save) and, when the recording was folded into a same-night session (the entry has another id), remembers the fold (foldedInto); posts flowRecoveryArchiveChanged (object = input session id) and posts flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload for the entry's id when the recording was folded (whatever requestingReupload says) or for a user edit of an already-archived session. Rethrows write errors after unlocking.

branches.effect: session.modifiedAt = stamp() (now, whole seconds); else stamp unchanged

branches.cond: folded, or requestingReupload for an already-archived session
branches.effect: posts re-upload request for entry.sessionId; a brand-new session gets none (normal upload path covers it)

units.does: Under archiveLock: the id of the same-night session the recording was folded into during this launch, else the id itself.

Read-modify-write under one lock that always writes: updateIfChanged with a closure that applies the change and reports it changed, so it retrieves the full session (hash-verified), applies the closure, optionally stamps modifiedAt, writes it with skipSameNightMerge: true, then posts flowRecoveryArchiveChanged and, if requestingReupload (default true), the re-upload request.

branches.cond: updateIfChanged throws (session not found, or the write fails)

units.contract: Under one lock, retrieves the full session, applies the change and always writes it (skipSameNightMerge: true), stamping modifiedAt when requestingReupload is true (the default). After the write it posts flowRecoveryArchiveChanged and, if requestingReupload, the re-upload request. Rethrows if the session is not found or the write fails.

units.does: Read-modify-write under one lock: retrieves the full session (hash-verified) and applies the closure, which returns whether it changed the session. When it returns false nothing is written, modifiedAt keeps its value, no notification is posted and it returns false. Otherwise it optionally stamps modifiedAt, writes it with skipSameNightMerge: true, posts flowRecoveryArchiveChanged and, if requestingReupload (default true), the re-upload request, and returns true.

branches.effect: unlocks and returns false: nothing written, stamped or posted
posts the re-upload request; returns true

units.does: Posts flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload with userInfo sessionIds = {id}; CloudKitSyncManager.observeReuploadSignals marks them for re-upload.
Locked full retrieve (decrypt, hash-verify, decode) of a session by id via _retrieve; nil if not indexed, throws on read/verify errors.
Calls retrieve; on throw logs '[SessionArchive] caller: failed to retrieve' and returns nil. A session that is not found gives nil without a log.

branches.effect: error logged at info level and swallowed, nil returned — callers fall back to the copy they held

units.contract: Returns what retrieve returns for the id. If retrieve throws, the error is logged and swallowed and nil is returned; it never throws. It also returns nil, without logging, when the session is not found, so a nil result does not mean an error was logged.

units.does: Lightweight retrieve (no rrSeries, no hash check); on success increments totalReadAttempts under lock; on failure records the failure (EPERM counters) and logs, returning nil.
units.contract: Returns the session's lightweight copy (no rrSeries, no hash check), or nil when the retrieve fails; it never throws. Success increments totalReadAttempts; a failure is recorded in the archive's read-failure counters and logged.

units.does: Under lock increments totalReadAttempts and, when the error is NSCocoaError 257 (no read permission) or wraps POSIX EPERM (1), permissionDeniedReadFailures.

branches.effect: counts a permission-denied failure; any other error counts only as an attempt

units.does: Looks up the entry under the lock only (store.entryById, the lock already held), resolves its file URL, then outside the lock checks existence, reads, decrypts/legacy-resolves via ArchiveStore.plaintextBytes and decodes with lightweightSessionDecoder (rrSeries skipped).
